mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_CareTeamGating allows Alloy to construct a world where a clinical user without any active care-team row has Permitted outcome on RecordsLookup or AddNote. The injection forces exactly that scenario, which OwnershipBasedAccess and FR_004_CareTeamGating are designed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGatingViolation { some op: Operation | (op.opKind = RecordsLookup or op.opKind = AddNote) and op.opOutcome = Permitted and op.opUser.userRole != HospitalAdministrator and (no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.ctClinician = op.opUser and ctm.ctPatient = op.opPatient and ctm.ctStatus = Active) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_NoteLinkedToOperation allows a ClinicalNote to exist that is not produced by any Operation, or to be claimed by two different Operations, violating the append-only and one-creator invariants. The injection forces two distinct operations to reference the same note, which AppendOnly and FR_011_NotesAppendOnly catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj op1, op2: Operation | op1.opNote = op2.opNote and some op1.opNote }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditEntriesAppendOnly allows two distinct Operations to share a single AuditEntry, violating both the one-audit-per-operation invariant and the immutability/append-only guarantee. The injection forces exactly that.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditAppendOnlyViolation { some disj op1, op2: Operation | op1.opAudit = op2.opAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_LeastPrivilegeEnforced allows a HospitalAdministrator to have a Permitted RecordsLookup or AddNote outcome, which LeastPrivilege is designed to catch. The injection forces that forbidden cell to be present.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | op.opUser.userRole = HospitalAdministrator and op.opKind = RecordsLookup and op.opOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_NoteAuthorIsClinical allows a ClinicalNote to have noteAuthorRole = HospitalAdministrator, which the data-model CHECK and FR-005 prohibit. The injection forces a note whose author role is the administrator role.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoteAuthorViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | n.noteAuthorRole = HospitalAdministrator }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditNoteIdConstraint allows an AuditEntry with aeOutcome=Denied to carry a non-null aeNoteRef, which would leak the existence of a note to a denied accessor and violate the structural CHECK in the data model. The injection forces a denied audit entry to carry a note reference.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditNoteIdViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeOutcome = Denied and ae.aeAccessType = AddNoteAccess and one ae.aeNoteRef }
